# Requirements Checklist: Installation, Login, and Persistence

**Purpose**: Validate requirement quality for the full installation/login specification, with strict checks for environment selection and exact persistence key definitions.  
**Created**: 2026-05-07  
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are requirements defined for an installation environment dropdown (available options, default selection, and selection rules)? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK002 Are requirements explicit about where the selected environment is stored and when it is read during startup and API routing? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK003 Are tenant and store identifier persistence requirements fully specified for installation success, including overwrite behavior on reinstall? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK004 Are login persistence requirements complete for access token, user ID, user name, and tenant data fields? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK005 Are failure-path persistence requirements specified (what must not be written on failed install/login responses)? [Gap, Spec §FR-006, Spec §FR-012]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Are exact app preference key names defined for tenant ID and store ID saved from installation response? [Clarity, Gap]
- [ ] CHK007 Are exact app preference key names defined for access token, user ID, user name, and each tenant data field from login response? [Clarity, Gap]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the term "same keys" clarified so it cannot be interpreted as key reuse that causes data collisions? [Ambiguity, Gap]
- [ ] CHK009 Is environment dropdown behavior quantified clearly for first install, reinstall, and app restart scenarios? [Clarity, Gap]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK010 Do persistence requirements align with the forced one-time new installation rule when the new flow flag is enabled? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK011 Do requirements consistently define that login uses saved install context while login UI remains PIN-only? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, Spec §FR-009, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK012 Are cluster editability requirements consistent across user stories and functional requirements without duplicated/conflicting statements? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 1, Spec §FR-003]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK013 Are acceptance scenarios measurable for environment selection and persisted-key outcomes (including expected saved values)? [Acceptance Criteria, Gap]
- [ ] CHK014 Are success criteria defined for data integrity of persisted values across app restarts and re-authentication cycles? [Measurability, Gap]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK015 Are alternate scenarios defined for changing environment before submit and handling invalid environment selection? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK016 Are exception scenarios defined for partial login responses (e.g., missing tenantData fields) and their persistence handling? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK017 Are recovery requirements defined for reinstall after previously saved invalid/stale keys? [Coverage, Recovery Flow, Gap]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK018 Are requirements defined for key migration/conflict behavior when old workflow keys already exist? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK019 Are requirements defined for duplicate key writes across rapid repeated submissions (install/login retried quickly)? [Edge Case, Gap]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK020 Are security requirements explicit for storage protection of access token and tenant/user identifiers at rest? [Non-Functional, Security, Gap]
- [ ] CHK021 Are observability requirements specified for audit-safe logging around install/login persistence events without exposing secrets? [Non-Functional, Observability, Gap]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK022 Are assumptions about API response field presence (tenant/store IDs, tenantData shape) explicitly documented as requirements or validated constraints? [Assumption, Spec §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK023 Are dependency requirements clear for environment-driven API base selection and fallback behavior when environment config is missing? [Dependency, Gap]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK024 Is there a canonical glossary for "environment," "tenant," "store," "device store," and "tenantData" to avoid term overlap? [Ambiguity, Gap]
- [ ] CHK025 Are requirement IDs unique and non-duplicated in the spec to support traceable review (e.g., repeated FR-003)? [Traceability, Conflict, Spec §Functional Requirements]
